verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage publishes a per-endpoint API reference (e.g. /reference/ pages for monitoring, exports, audit and transactions) and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema, which a probe retrieved unauthenticated. Runnable examples come only through an official Postman collection, an external tool, rather than an in-docs interactive console. The 404s on standard OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the schema was found at a different path. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive 'try it' console in the reference, in-page runnable code samples, hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
